# BC Atlas ontology

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-docs.js. Do not edit this file. -->

Apps, namespaces, architecture components, AL objects, their members, and their relations, as found by BC Atlas in AL source. The vocabulary of the
[knowledge graph export](../knowledge-graph.md) (`bca export --view knowledge-graph`).

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Ontology IRI | `https://schulzoli.github.io/BC-Atlas/ontology` |
| Namespace | `https://schulzoli.github.io/BC-Atlas/ontology#` (prefix `bca:`) |
| Version | 0.12.0 |
| License | MIT |
| Download | [Turtle](https://schulzoli.github.io/BC-Atlas/ontology.ttl) · [OWL (RDF/XML)](https://schulzoli.github.io/BC-Atlas/ontology.owl) · [RDF/XML](https://schulzoli.github.io/BC-Atlas/ontology.rdf) · [N-Triples](https://schulzoli.github.io/BC-Atlas/ontology.nt) · [JSON-LD](https://schulzoli.github.io/BC-Atlas/ontology.jsonld) |

Every export already contains these terms, so a graph loads without this
page. Each term's IRI leads to its row here: `bca:Table` is
`https://schulzoli.github.io/BC-Atlas/ontology#Table`. Tools that need RDF take one of the
downloads; in Protégé, **File › Open from URL** with the OWL link.

## Classes

Every AL object is an instance of its type's class, which is a subclass of
`bca:Object` (extensions also of `bca:ExtensionObject`).

| Class | Label | Subclass of | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <a id="App"></a>`bca:App` | AL app |  | An extension or app with its own app.json. |
| <a id="Namespace"></a>`bca:Namespace` | AL namespace |  | A namespace declared by AL objects. |
| <a id="Component"></a>`bca:Component` | Architecture component |  | A component of the target architecture in .bca.json, or of a proposal. |
| <a id="Object"></a>`bca:Object` | AL object |  | An application object such as a table, page, or codeunit. |
| <a id="ExtensionObject"></a>`bca:ExtensionObject` | AL extension object | [`bca:Object`](#Object) | An object that extends another object: a table, page, report, enum, profile, or permission set extension, or a page customization. |
| <a id="ExternalObject"></a>`bca:ExternalObject` | External AL object | [`bca:Object`](#Object) | An object referenced by the workspace but declared elsewhere, for example in the Base Application. |
| <a id="Field"></a>`bca:Field` | Field |  | A field of a table or table extension. |
| <a id="Key"></a>`bca:Key` | Key |  | A key of a table. |
| <a id="Procedure"></a>`bca:Procedure` | Procedure |  | A procedure of an object. |
| <a id="Trigger"></a>`bca:Trigger` | Trigger | [`bca:Procedure`](#Procedure) | A trigger of an object, such as OnRun or OnValidate. |
| <a id="EventPublisher"></a>`bca:EventPublisher` | Event publisher | [`bca:Procedure`](#Procedure) | A procedure with an integration or business event attribute. |
| <a id="Relation"></a>`bca:Relation` | Relation |  | One relation found in the source, with its kind, confidence, and location (a qualified form of the direct relation property). |
| <a id="ArchitectureViolation"></a>`bca:ArchitectureViolation` | Architecture violation |  | A dependency between two objects that points against the architecture. |
| <a id="Table"></a>`bca:Table` | Table | [`bca:Object`](#Object) |  |
| <a id="TableExtension"></a>`bca:TableExtension` | Table extension | [`bca:ExtensionObject`](#ExtensionObject) |  |
| <a id="Page"></a>`bca:Page` | Page | [`bca:Object`](#Object) |  |
| <a id="PageExtension"></a>`bca:PageExtension` | Page extension | [`bca:ExtensionObject`](#ExtensionObject) |  |
| <a id="PageCustomization"></a>`bca:PageCustomization` | Page customization | [`bca:ExtensionObject`](#ExtensionObject) |  |
| <a id="Codeunit"></a>`bca:Codeunit` | Codeunit | [`bca:Object`](#Object) |  |
| <a id="Report"></a>`bca:Report` | Report | [`bca:Object`](#Object) |  |
| <a id="ReportExtension"></a>`bca:ReportExtension` | Report extension | [`bca:ExtensionObject`](#ExtensionObject) |  |
| <a id="Query"></a>`bca:Query` | Query | [`bca:Object`](#Object) |  |
| <a id="XmlPort"></a>`bca:XmlPort` | XMLport | [`bca:Object`](#Object) |  |
| <a id="Enum"></a>`bca:Enum` | Enum | [`bca:Object`](#Object) |  |
| <a id="EnumExtension"></a>`bca:EnumExtension` | Enum extension | [`bca:ExtensionObject`](#ExtensionObject) |  |
| <a id="Interface"></a>`bca:Interface` | Interface | [`bca:Object`](#Object) |  |
| <a id="ControlAddIn"></a>`bca:ControlAddIn` | Control add-in | [`bca:Object`](#Object) |  |
| <a id="Profile"></a>`bca:Profile` | Profile | [`bca:Object`](#Object) |  |
| <a id="ProfileExtension"></a>`bca:ProfileExtension` | Profile extension | [`bca:ExtensionObject`](#ExtensionObject) |  |

## Relations between objects

One property per kind of relation the analysis finds, each a sub-property
of [`bca:dependsOn`](#dependsOn): a store with RDFS inference answers
`?a bca:dependsOn ?b` for all of them. Each relation is also a
[`bca:Relation`](#Relation) with its evidence, unless the export used
`--no-evidence`.

| Property | Label | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <a id="calls"></a>`bca:calls` | calls | Calls a procedure of the target. |
| <a id="reads"></a>`bca:reads` | reads | Reads records of the target table. |
| <a id="writes"></a>`bca:writes` | writes | Inserts, modifies, or deletes records of the target table. |
| <a id="relatesTo"></a>`bca:relatesTo` | relates to | A table relation to the target table. |
| <a id="uses"></a>`bca:uses` | uses | Declares a variable or parameter of the target type. |
| <a id="extends"></a>`bca:extends` | extends | Extends the target object. |
| <a id="implements"></a>`bca:implements` | implements | Implements the target interface. |
| <a id="selects"></a>`bca:selects` | selects | Selects an implementation through an enum value. |
| <a id="publishes"></a>`bca:publishes` | publishes | Publishes an event of the target. |
| <a id="subscribesTo"></a>`bca:subscribesTo` | subscribes to | Subscribes to an event of the target. |
| <a id="runs"></a>`bca:runs` | runs | Runs the target page, report, or codeunit. |
| <a id="hasPart"></a>`bca:hasPart` | has part | Shows the target page as a part. |
| <a id="contains"></a>`bca:contains` | contains | Contains the target. |
| <a id="permits"></a>`bca:permits` | permits | A permission set grants access to the target. |
| <a id="includes"></a>`bca:includes` | includes | A permission set includes the target permission set. |
| <a id="starts"></a>`bca:starts` | starts | Starts the target. |
| <a id="raisesEvent"></a>`bca:raisesEvent` | raises event | Raises an event of the target. |
